MAR.note: Training is for young people, not civil servants.
Digital skills labs only; no internet access programme or rural/urban use figure.

facts.fact: The ST Foundation says its Digital Unify programme, run in Morocco since 2004 in partnership with the Ministry of Youth, operates 45 labs in 17 cities, trained 25,765 people in 2025 and has reached over 270,000 since launch.

systems.owner: ST Foundation with Ministry of Youth
